ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The following figure shows the transfer of energy through a forest community. According to the information in the figure, what is the proportion of energy entering the first trophic level that is passed to the second trophic level? Express your answer as a value between 0 and 1, rounded to the nearest hundredth.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows solar energy on the left, with an arrow labeled 2.5 × 10^4 kJ/m² entering the producers box. From the producers box, an arrow labeled 3 × 10^3 kJ/m² goes to the herbivores box. Reasoning: The first trophic level is producers, and the second trophic level is herbivores. The requested proportion is the energy passed to herbivores divided by the energy entering producers: (3 × 10^3) / (2.5 × 10^4) = 3000 / 25000 = 0.12. Rounded to the nearest hundredth, this remains 0.12.
